{{Top|leg}}
'''Hatching caves''' were certain natural caverns on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pochi]] where the [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Tulvaree]]s laid their [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] until the young emerged. The [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Faarl]] the Conqueror could see the hatching caves from his headquarters, the [[Fortress Baarlos]].
